items.why: Quote states Ramp uses OAuth 2.0; matches oauth2 method. 'Only' not stated.

items.quote: Use this flow for server-to-server integrations with your own Ramp business.
items.why: Quote covers only the client-credentials server-to-server flow, not oauth2 overall.

items.quote: This guide assumes you are a Ramp customer with **admin** access to your dashboard.
items.why: Quote assumes customer with admin access; not stated as a gate for credentials.

items.quote: Some endpoints also require a Ramp plan feature and return `403` without it, even with the right scope.
items.why: Plan-feature 403 gate is real, but claim's key point is customer account gate.

items.quote: The Ramp sandbox is a testing environment where developers and partners can safely build, test, and experiment
items.why: Describes sandbox purpose only; says nothing about customer-account credential gate.

items.quote: The API exposes Custom Records, Webhooks for event-driven integrations, and the full Ramp data model.
items.why: Mentions Custom Records, Webhooks, full data model; no REST, OpenAPI, or scope list.

items.quote: Ramp runs two MCP servers, one for your Ramp account and one for Ramp Data benchmarks.
items.why: Confirms Ramp runs MCP servers (exists, official); URL mcp.ramp.com/mcp not in quote.
